title: Flex-$π$: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility
summary: World-action models (WAMs) predict the future to act better, but nearly all of them predict only RGB latents, trained purely for pixel reconstruction, with no explicit signal for the 3D geometry or object semantics manipulation needs. We find a surprising free lunch: the same frozen video-generation VAE that encodes RGB also encodes 3D pointmaps almost losslessly, with no pointmap-specific training at all. This lets us supervise Flex-$π$, a 6B-parameter WAM, on 3D geometry and object-centric DINO semantics alongside RGB, at no cost in new sensors, new pre-training, or inference latency. Every visual signal is projected into this shared latent space and denoised jointly with actions inside a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone; per-stream dropout with cross-modality forcing then lets a single trained checkpoint run on any subset of these streams, from a fast action-only mode to full joint generation. The result is a policy that is exceptionally demonstration-efficient and generalizes well, beating the strongest baselines by up to 2-7$\times$ on dexterous, precise, real-world bimanual manipulation tasks both in and out of distribution, all while running faster than $π_{0.5}$. Our project website: https://flex-pi.github.io/
tldr: Flex-π is a 6B-parameter world-action model that jointly denoises RGB, 3D pointmap geometry, and DINO semantics in a shared latent space using a pretrained VAE, enabling a single checkpoint to run in multiple modes (from fast action-only to full joint generation) and achieving up to 2-7× improvement on real-world bimanual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Flex-π 是一个60亿参数的世界-动作模型，利用预训练VAE在共享潜空间中联合去噪RGB、3D点图几何和DINO语义，使得单个检查点能以多种模式运行（从快速纯动作到完整联合生成），在真实世界双臂操作任务上取得了2-7倍的提升。
summary_zh: 世界-行动模型（WAMs）通过预测未来以优化行动表现，但现有模型几乎全部仅预测RGB潜在变量，纯粹为像素重建而训练，缺乏三维几何或物体语义操作所需的显式信号。我们发现一个惊人的“免费午餐”：同一套冻结的视频生成VAE在编码RGB的同时，几乎无损失地编码了三维点图，且完全无需针对点图的专门训练。这使得我们能够在RGB基础上，以零成本新增传感器、预训练或推理延迟，对参数规模为6B的WAM模型Flex-$π$同时实施三维几何、以物体为中心的DINO语义以及RGB的监督训练。所有视觉信号被投影至共享潜在空间，并在混合变换器骨干网络内与动作联合去噪；通过跨模态强制实施的逐流随机丢弃机制，使得单个训练完成的检查点能够运行于上述信号流的任意子集——从仅含动作的快速模式到完整的联合生成模式。最终得到的策略具有卓越的示范效率与泛化能力，在灵巧、精密且需双手协同的实际操作任务中（涵盖分布内与分布外场景），将最强基线方法的性能提升2-7倍，同时运行速度超越$π_{0.5}$。项目网站：https://flex-pi.github.io/

title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Action verbs describe not only the physical outcomes of actions, but also how those actions are performed. Yet action representations in vision-language-action models (VLAs) are typically optimized for reconstruction under L1/L2 losses in raw action space, where numerical proximity need not reflect linguistically meaningful distinctions. On BridgeV2, we show that action trajectories contain verb-grounding information beyond visual state changes, and that reconstruction-only discrete tokenization systematically erodes this information. To address this problem, we introduce SALT, a Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer that augments a VQ-VAE-style tokenizer with an auxiliary objective requiring a frozen vision-language model to recover the episode instruction from quantized action latents. Policies trained with SALT achieve 71.9% average success in SimplerEnv, compared with 42.7% for a reconstruction-only VQ-VAE tokenizer and 31.2% for FAST. SALT also develops verb-specialized codes while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. These results show that robot action trajectories provide a source of language grounding and that preserving this structure in action representations can substantially improve language-conditioned control.
tldr: SALT introduces a semantically aligned action tokenizer for VLA models that preserves verb-grounding information in action representations, significantly improving language-conditioned robotic control.
tldr_zh: SALT 提出了一种语义对齐的动作分词器，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，保留动作表示中的动词接地信息，显著提升了语言条件机器人控制性能。
summary_zh: 动作动词不仅描述动作的物理结果，还描述了这些动作的执行方式。然而，视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）中的动作表征通常针对原始动作空间中的L1/L2损失进行重构优化，而数值上的相近性未必能反映具有语言学意义的区分。在BridgeV2上，我们证明动作轨迹包含超出视觉状态变化的动词基础信息，且仅依赖重构的离散分词化会系统性侵蚀此类信息。为解决该问题，我们提出SALT——一种语义对齐的动作分词器，通过引入辅助目标增强VQ-VAE风格的分词器，该目标要求冻结的视觉-语言模型从量化后的动作隐变量中恢复出情节指令。使用SALT训练的策略在SimplerEnv中实现了71.9%的平均成功率，相比之下，仅使用重构VQ-VAE分词器与FAST分别仅为42.7%与31.2%。SALT在保持重构保真度的同时，还发展出了动词专用编码。这些结果表明，机器人动作轨迹提供了语言基础信息的来源，在动作表征中保留该结构可显著提升语言条件化控制性能。

title: XCoT-VLA: Executable Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can connect scene understanding, semantic reasoning, and trajectory generation for autonomous driving. However, verbose natural-language Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is poorly suited to real-time control because it is open-ended, costly to decode, and difficult to optimize as an action-facing representation. We propose XCoT-VLA, which replaces descriptive rationales with compact executable CoT tokens learned from automatically constructed Reason-Action supervision. Logged trajectories provide action evidence, while scene context supplies causal semantics. The predicted XCoT sequence remains in context and conditions fixed trajectory queries through shared multimodal self-attention. Deterministic token-function routing applies the Reason FFN to XCoT tokens and the Control FFN to trajectory queries for flow-matching trajectory generation. We further introduce XCoT Policy Optimization (XCPO) as an optional refinement extension in the same executable token space. XCoT-VLA reduces longitudinal ADE from 1.645 to 1.323 on a general-distribution set and lateral FDE from 1.616 to 0.648 in lane-change scenarios. By representing driving-oriented reasoning with only 2-6 executable XCoT tokens, our method substantially reduces autoregressive reasoning overhead and remains within the real-time planning budget. These results demonstrate that driving-oriented reasoning can be compact, executable, and directly connected to trajectory generation.
tldr: XCoT-VLA replaces verbose natural-language Chain-of-Thought with compact executable tokens for driving reasoning, reducing autoregressive overhead while improving trajectory prediction accuracy.
tldr_zh: XCoT-VLA 用紧凑的可执行令牌取代冗长的自然语言思维链，用于驾驶推理，在减少自回归开销的同时提高轨迹预测精度。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够为自动驾驶融合场景理解、语义推理与轨迹生成。然而，冗长的自然语言思维链（CoT）因其开放性、解码成本高且难以作为面向动作的表征进行优化，并不适用于实时控制。我们提出XCoT-VLA，使用从自动构建的推理-动作监督中学习到的紧凑可执行CoT标记替代描述性解释。记录轨迹提供动作证据，场景上下文提供因果语义。预测的XCoT序列保持上下文一致，并通过共享的多模态自注意力机制调节固定轨迹查询。确定性标记-函数路由将推理前馈网络应用于XCoT标记，控制前馈网络应用于轨迹查询，以实现流匹配轨迹生成。我们进一步提出XCoT策略优化（XCPO），作为同一可执行标记空间中的可选细化扩展。XCoT-VLA在通用分布数据集上将纵向平均位移误差从1.645降至1.323，在换道场景中将横向最终位移误差从1.616降至0.648。通过仅使用2-6个可执行XCoT标记表示驾驶导向推理，本方法大幅降低自回归推理开销，并保持在实时规划预算内。这些结果表明，驾驶导向推理可以做到紧凑、可执行，并与轨迹生成直接关联。

title: DriveVLA-M0: Failure-Aware Memory Augmentation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by enabling unified reasoning across perception, language, and planning. However, existing approaches lack mechanisms to exploit past failures or adapt to distribution shifts, causing the model to persistently underperform on similar scenarios where it has previously failed. In this paper, we propose DriveVLA-M0, a retrieval-augmented VLA with failure-aware latent memory. We construct a latent memory pool that stores failure cases along with their structure scene representations and expert trajectory labels, and design a dedicated Retrieve Model that decouples static road structure and dynamic agent interactions to enable structurally grounded retrieval. At inference time, retrieved cases are injected into the model via a lightweight decoupled LoRA-based test-time training (TTT) mechanism, allowing targeted and scenario-specific correction without modifying the backbone. Extensive experiments on NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmark demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving 94.1 PDMS on Navtest and 47.0 EPDMS on Navhard with only 26.44 ms TTT backward latency overhead. Furthermore, we show that DriveVLA-M0 scales effectively with additional memory, enabling training-free performance gains through memory expansion. The code is available at https://github.com/ZebinX/DriveVLA-M0.
tldr: DriveVLA-M0 augments VLA models for autonomous driving with a failure-aware memory pool and decoupled retrieval plus test-time LoRA adaptation, improving closed-loop performance without backbone retraining.
tldr_zh: DriveVLA-M0 通过构建故障感知记忆池和基于解耦检索的测试时自适应机制，提升了自动驾驶 VLA 模型在闭环任务中的表现，无需重新训练骨干网络。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过实现感知、语言与规划的统一推理，近期已成为端到端自动驾驶领域颇具前景的研究范式。然而，现有方法缺乏利用过往失败经验或适应分布偏移的机制，导致模型在曾失败的相似场景中持续表现不佳。本文提出DriveVLA-M0——一种具有失败感知潜在记忆的检索增强型VLA模型。我们构建了一个存储失败案例及其结构化场景表征和专家轨迹标签的潜在记忆池，并设计了专用的检索模型，该模型将静态道路结构与动态智能体交互解耦，以实现基于结构对齐的检索。在推理阶段，通过轻量级解耦型LoRA测试时训练机制将检索案例注入模型，无需修改主干网络即可实现针对性的场景特定修正。在NAVSIMv1和NAVSIMv2基准上的大量实验表明，本方法持续优于先前方法，在Navtest上达到94.1 PDMS，在Navhard上达到47.0 EPDMS，且仅产生26.44毫秒的TTT反向传播延迟开销。此外，我们证明DriveVLA-M0能够随记忆扩容有效扩展，通过扩展记忆实现无需训练的性能提升。代码开源于https://github.com/ZebinX/DriveVLA-M0。

title: 4D-WAM: 4D Consistent World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Emerging World-Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated promising performance in autonomous driving by jointly modeling future driving scene evolution and trajectory planning. However, existing WAMs are typically trained with video data, which is only 2D projections of the underlying 4D driving scene. Consequently, WAMs fail to understand and capture the structure of 4D scenes and thus generate visually plausible yet 4D inconsistent future predictions that mislead downstream planning. To alleviate this issue, we present 4D-WAM, a model that leverages geometric foundation models for training-time supervision to enable 4D consistent world modeling. Specifically, we feed WAM-predicted future frames into a geometric foundation model, and use 4D-aware responses to define a 4D consistency loss. This loss encourages the model to understand, represent, and predict physically consistent 4D scenes during training, without additional inference cost. Moreover, we identify an early-decision phenomenon in WAMs and propose a decision-oriented timestep sampling strategy that emphasizes supervision at early, high-noise stages, where driving decisions are primarily formed. By propagating 4D supervision to this critical decision-formation phase, the proposed strategy further improves trajectory planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that 4D-WAM effectively models 4D consistent scene evolution and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks.
tldr: 4D-WAM introduces a 4D consistency loss using geometric foundation models to train world-action models for autonomous driving, improving scene evolution and trajectory planning without additional inference cost.
tldr_zh: 4D-WAM 利用几何基础模型引入 4D 一致性损失来训练自动驾驶世界动作模型，在不增加推理成本的情况下改进了场景演化和轨迹规划。
summary_zh: 新兴世界-行动模型（WAMs）通过联合建模未来驾驶场景演化与轨迹规划，在自动驾驶领域展现出显著潜力。然而，现有WAMs通常仅基于视频数据训练，而视频仅为底层四维驾驶场景的二维投影。这导致WAMs无法理解并捕捉四维场景的结构信息，从而生成视觉合理但存在四维一致性问题（4D inconsistent）的未来预测，进而误导下游规划任务。为解决该问题，我们提出4D-WAM——通过几何基础模型在训练阶段提供监督信号，实现四维一致世界建模的模型。具体而言，我们将WAM预测的未来帧输入几何基础模型，并利用四维感知响应定义四维一致性损失函数。该损失函数在训练过程中促使模型理解、表征并生成物理一致的四维场景，且无需增加额外推理成本。此外，我们发现了WAMs中的早期决策现象，并提出面向决策的时间步采样策略，该策略强化了对早期高噪声阶段的监督——此阶段正是驾驶决策形成的关键时期。通过将四维监督信号传播至这一关键决策形成阶段，所提策略进一步优化了轨迹规划。大量实验表明，4D-WAM能有效建模四维一致场景演化，并在具有挑战性的NAVSIM-v1与NAVSIM-v2基准测试中取得最优性能。

title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models map camera images and language instructions directly to motor commands through a single autoregressive transformer. In real-time control, they still spend substantial compute recomputing key-value(KV) representations for visual tokens that barely change across neighboring frames. Recent work such as VLA-Cache reduces that cost by reusing KV states for visually static patches, but its policy relies only on observation-space heuristics and does not account for the model's own uncertainty. We propose Gated VLA-Cache, a lightweight, training-free extension that augments visual-similarity caching with neural introspection. The method monitors the logit margin between the top two predicted action tokens, a zero-cost confidence signal available during decoding. When the margin drops below a threshold, the cache is invalidated and a full recompute is triggered. Evaluated on four LIBERO benchmark suites with both OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT, Gated VLA-Cache improves reliability when blind caching hurts. On LIBERO-Goal and LIBERO-Long, it recovers over 100% of the lost accuracy while retaining 80% of the compute savings.
tldr: Proposes Gated VLA-Cache, a training-free method that uses logit-margin confidence from the VLA model to adaptively invalidate KV-cache reuse, improving reliability on LIBERO benchmarks while retaining 80% compute savings.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无训练的门控VLA缓存方法，利用VLA模型的logit边缘置信度自适应地失效KV缓存重用，在LIBERO基准上提高可靠性同时保留80%的计算节省。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过单一的自回归变换器将相机图像和语言指令直接映射为电机指令。在实时控制中，它们仍需消耗大量计算资源，反复重新计算相邻帧中几乎未发生变化的视觉令牌的键值（KV）表示。近期研究如VLA-Cache通过复用视觉静态补丁的KV状态来降低计算成本，但其策略仅依赖于观测空间的启发式规则，未考虑模型自身的不确定性。我们提出Gated VLA-Cache——一种轻量级、无需训练的扩展方法，通过神经内省机制增强视觉相似性缓存。该方法监测最高两个预测动作令牌之间的logit差值，这是解码过程中可用的零成本置信度信号。当该差值低于阈值时，缓存失效并触发完整重新计算。在OpenVLA和OpenVLA-OFT两种模型下，针对四个LIBERO基准套件的评估表明，Gated VLA-Cache在盲目缓存导致性能下降时显著提升了可靠性。在LIBERO-Goal和LIBERO-Long任务中，该方法在保留80%计算节省的同时，恢复了超过100%的精度损失。

title: AECNav: Active Evidence Consolidation for Efficient Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation
summary: Zero-shot object-goal navigation (ZSON) in open-vocabulary scenarios is challenging, as it requires a robot to locate an arbitrarily specified object in an unseen environment without task-specific training. Currently, the task still suffers from high latency and limited accuracy due to redundant perception pipelines and insufficient evidence for reliable target confirmation. In this letter, we reframe ZSON as an evidence-driven perception-to-decision problem and present AECNav, a training-free pipeline built on three components: i) Evidence-gated perception, which utilizes a shared encoding across all reasoning stages to establish a unified semantic basis and eliminate redundant computations; ii) Evidence consolidation, which aggregates detections into cluster-level log-odds beliefs. This explicitly separates genuine target support from the false confidence of visually similar distractors, while treating the absence of expected detections as negative evidence; and iii) Active evidence acquisition, which sustains productive exploration under weak semantic cues by selecting frontiers that maximize information gain at minimal traversal cost. As a result, AECNav significantly outperforms previous methods and achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 84.7%, 57.3%, and 51.3% on HM3D-v2, HM3D-OVON, and MP3D, respectively, with substantially lower inference overhead, and attains 95% success across 40 trials on a physical quadruped robot at roughly 5Hz. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
tldr: AECNV proposes a training-free, zero-shot open-vocabulary object navigation pipeline that uses evidence-gated perception, evidence consolidation, and active evidence acquisition to achieve state-of-the-art success rates with low latency on both simulated and real robot platforms.
tldr_zh: AECNav提出了一种无需训练、零样本开放词汇目标导航流水线，通过证据门控感知、证据整合与主动证据获取，在仿真和真实机器人平台上实现了领先的成功率与低延迟。
summary_zh: 开放词汇场景中的零样本目标导航（ZSON）具有挑战性，因为它要求机器人在未经任务特定训练的情况下，在未知环境中定位任意指定的物体。目前，由于冗余的感知流程和缺乏可靠的目标确认证据，该任务仍存在高延迟和精度有限的问题。本文将该任务重构为证据驱动的感知-决策问题，并提出AECNav——一种无需训练的流水线，由三个模块组成：i) 证据门控感知，在所有推理阶段共享编码以建立统一的语义基础并消除冗余计算；ii) 证据整合，将检测结果聚合为聚类级的对数几率置信度，从而明确区分真实目标支持与视觉相似干扰物的虚假置信度，同时将预期检测的缺失视为负证据；iii) 主动证据获取，通过选择以最小遍历成本最大化信息增益的前沿边界，在弱语义线索下维持高效探索。实验表明，AECNav显著优于先前方法，在HM3D-v2、HM3D-OVON和MP3D数据集上分别达到84.7%、57.3%和51.3%的最优成功率，推理开销大幅降低；在物理四足机器人上，40次试验中成功率达95%，运行频率约5Hz。代码将在论文接收后公开。

title: JEPA-WAM: Stage-Level Joint-Embedding Prediction for World-Action Models in Robot Manipulation
summary: Generalist robot policies aim to map multimodal observations and linguistic task instructions to actions across diverse tasks. However, existing methods typically represent the future as a fixed, short video-action chunk. This short-term future captures local scene evolution for action execution, but it does not explicitly describe the stage-level future that specifies how a task should progress from its current stage to the next. We therefore distinguish two complementary futures for robot manipulation: a short-term physical future to capture local scene evolution and a stage-level semantic future to represent task progress. We introduce JEPA-WAM, which augments a Motus-based World Action Model (WAM) with Stage-JEPA, a goal-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) predictor. Given the current observation and task instruction, Stage-JEPA uses a frozen V-JEPA2 encoder to extract the current-state representation and predicts the latent target of the next inferred stage. Across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks in clean and randomized environments, JEPA-WAM achieves 90.25% overall success and reduces the mean number of execution steps in successful rollouts by 5.97% relative to the strongest baseline.
tldr: JEPA-WAM augments a World Action Model with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to predict stage-level semantic future representations, improving success rate and efficiency in robot manipulation across 50 tasks.
tldr_zh: JEPA-WAM 通过联合嵌入预测架构增强世界行动模型，以预测阶段级语义未来表征，从而提高机器人操作的成功率和效率。
summary_zh: 通用机器人策略旨在将多模态观测与语言任务指令映射为跨多样任务的动作。然而，现有方法通常将未来表征为固定、短时的视频-动作片段。这种短时未来虽然能捕捉用于动作执行的局部场景演变，却无法明确描述规定任务应从当前阶段推进至下一阶段的阶段级未来状态。因此，我们为机器人操作区分了两种互补的未来表征：用于捕捉局部场景演变的短时物理未来，以及表征任务进程的阶段级语义未来。我们提出JEPA-WAM，该方法以基于Motus的世界动作模型（WAM）为核心，通过Stage-JEPA——一种目标条件联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）预测器——对其进行增强。给定当前观测与任务指令，Stage-JEPA利用冻结的V-JEPA2编码器提取当前状态表征，并预测下一推断阶段的潜在目标。在清洁与随机化环境下的50项RoboTwin 2.0任务中，JEPA-WAM实现了90.25%的总体成功率，相较于最强基线，成功轨迹中的平均执行步数减少了5.97%。

title: Embodied Multimodal Grounding for Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation via Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Embodied mobile manipulation requires language, visual observations, three-dimensional scene structure, and action feasibility to be aligned before execution. We study open-vocabulary target grounding with few-shot manipulation in local household workspaces and present an embodied multimodal grounding framework that integrates active multi-view Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (Semantic-3DGS), reachability-aware base positioning, and a diffusion-based vision-language-action policy. A task-driven local Semantic-3DGS serves as a shared interface across active sensing, language-conditioned 3D localization, obstacle-aware scene reasoning, base preparation, and semantic conditioning of the action model. To preserve pretrained action priors, the 3D semantic cues are injected only into the late action-expert blocks. In expanded 50-trial real-robot evaluations against representative vision-language-action (VLA) approaches, the full system achieves 60% long-horizon success compared with 40% for PointVLA and 28% for DexVLA, and reaches 74% success in heavily cluttered manipulation compared with 52% for the single-view variant and 46% for PointVLA. It also maintains 75% success under a 75 cm height shift and eliminates photo-induced false grasps. These results indicate that explicit, refreshable 3D semantic grounding can improve robustness under clutter, occlusion, viewpoint variation, and embodiment constraints.
tldr: This paper presents an embodied multimodal grounding framework that uses active multi-view Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting for open-vocabulary mobile manipulation, achieving improved robustness and success rates over existing VLA methods in cluttered and viewpoint-varying real-robot scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种具身多模态接地框架，利用主动多视角语义3D高斯泼溅实现开放词汇的移动操作，在杂乱环境和视角变化下相比现有VLA方法取得了更高的鲁棒性和成功率。
summary_zh: 具身移动操作要求在任务执行前，将语言、视觉观测、三维场景结构与动作可行性进行对齐。我们研究在局部家庭工作空间中结合少样本操作的开词汇目标定位，并提出一个具身多模态定位框架，该框架集成了主动多视角语义三维高斯泼溅（Semantic-3DGS）、可达性感知的基座定位，以及基于扩散模型的视觉-语言-动作策略。任务驱动的局部语义三维高斯泼溅充当共享接口，衔接主动感知、语言条件下的三维定位、障碍物感知场景推理、基座准备以及动作模型的语义条件化。为保留预训练的动作先验，三维语义信息仅注入到动作专家模块的后端区块中。在与代表性视觉-语言-动作方法进行扩展的50次真实机器人对比实验中，本完整系统实现了60%的长时域成功率，而PointVLA为40%、DexVLA为28%；在高度杂乱的操作场景中达到74%的成功率，而单视角变体为52%、PointVLA为46%。该系统在75厘米高度偏移下仍保持75%的成功率，并消除了由光照导致的虚假抓取行为。这些结果表明，显式且可刷新的三维语义定位能在杂乱环境、遮挡、视角变化及具身约束下提升鲁棒性。

title: TCAM for Autonomous Deformable Manipulation: The RMC2 Champion System for WBCD 2026 Track 4
summary: This technical report describes the RMC2 Team's champion solution for the WBCD 2026 Track 4: Deformable Manipulation Challenge. The task requires a robot to pick a single T-shirt from a stack, load it onto a printing pallet, align the collar with a target area, and smooth the printing region, a sequence that involves single-layer separation, deformable transport, precise placement, and contact-rich surface adjustment. The competition strongly incentivizes fully autonomous execution, motivating the development of an autonomous solution. We built a fully autonomous system around the TCAM (TermiBrain Causal Action Model) framework, with the design principle that hardware, perception, data, and learning should jointly reduce the physical interaction complexity the policy must handle. A custom 3D-printed gripper designed for single-layer fabric separation improves picking reliability on a dual-arm ARX X5 platform. A wrist-centric four-camera setup pairs upper fisheye cameras for task-level context with lower RGB cameras for close-range gripper-cloth contact observation. We combine portable UMI-style demonstrations with real-robot demonstrations collected on the deployable platform to provide both broad manipulation priors and deployment-specific dynamics. TCAM ties these components into a closed loop: each trajectory is analyzed to identify the physical factors contributing to its outcome, driving targeted data recollection and policy fine-tuning. The policy outputs 30-step end-effector delta-pose action chunks from a multi-view VLA backbone. In the final competition, our system loaded 25 T-shirts at an average of approximately 23 seconds per attempt, with 22 achieving the required surface smoothness, securing first place in Track 4.
tldr: This paper presents the TCAM framework, a vision-language-action system that won the WBCD 2026 deformable manipulation challenge by integrating hardware design, multi-view perception, data collection, and closed-loop policy fine-tuning for autonomous T-shirt handling.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了TCAM框架，该框架通过整合硬件设计、多视角感知、数据收集和闭环策略微调，赢得了WBCD 2026可变形操作挑战赛的冠军，实现了T恤衫的自主处理。
summary_zh: 本技术报告介绍了RMC2团队在WBCD 2026第四赛道：可变形物体操作挑战中的冠军解决方案。该任务要求机器人在成堆衣物中拾取单件T恤，将其装载至印花托盘，使衣领对准目标区域，并抚平印花区域，这一流程涉及单层分离、可变形物体运输、精准放置以及接触丰富的表面调整。竞赛高度鼓励全自主执行，推动了自主解决方案的开发。我们基于TCAM（TermiBrain因果动作模型）框架构建了全自主系统，其设计原则为：硬件、感知、数据与学习应共同降低策略需处理的物理交互复杂度。针对单层织物分离设计的定制3D打印夹爪，在双臂ARX X5平台上提升了拾取可靠性。以腕部为中心的四摄像头配置中，上部鱼眼相机提供任务级全局视野，下部RGB相机用于近距离夹爪-织物接触观测。我们将便携式UMI风格演示与在部署平台上采集的真实机器人演示相结合，既提供广泛的操作先验知识，又包含部署特有的动力学特性。TCAM将这些组件整合为闭环：每段轨迹经分析后识别影响结果的关键物理因素，从而驱动针对性数据重采与策略微调。策略从多视角VLA主干网络输出30步末端执行器增量位姿动作片段。在最终比赛中，我们的系统以平均约23秒/次的速度装载了25件T恤，其中22件达到所需表面平滑度，荣获第四赛道第一名。

title: Toward the Cognitive--Physical Limits of Embodied Intelligence through a World-Model-Centric Autonomous Racing Agent
summary: Embodied artificial intelligence aims to develop agents that perceive, reason, and act through continuous interaction with the physical world. However, most embodied systems are still evaluated within conservative safety margins or moderate interaction regimes, leaving their capability boundaries under extreme conditions insufficiently understood. Autonomous racing provides a stringent testbed by combining high-frequency localization and perception, adversarial interaction, near-saturated vehicle dynamics, and strict safety constraints. Existing systems push high-speed performance but rarely model and refine cognitive and physical limits jointly. Here we show that a world-model-centric autonomous racing agent provides a concrete step toward exploring these coupled limits. The framework learns predictive world models from near-limit successes and failures to capture interaction evolution, ego dynamics, and feasible-motion boundaries, coupling world-state construction, future-aware reasoning, and near-limit control in a closed-loop refinement process. Training data were collected from real-vehicle autonomous racing, where the onboard system maintained robust localization and perception at speeds up to 256.3 km/h and peak lateral acceleration of 26.8 m/s$^2$. In full-scale simulated racing, the well trained world-model-centric agent achieves an 88.3% interaction success rate across various challenging simulated racing scenarios. Closed-loop refinement of the world model and policy further improved utilization of cognitive-physical limits, recovery from failure modes, and generalization across varying conditions and unseen circuits. These results suggest a boundary-aware methodology in which world models help embodied agents represent, predict, and continually refine their capability boundaries for safer real-world deployment.
tldr: This paper presents a world-model-centric autonomous racing agent that learns predictive world models from near-limit real-vehicle data to jointly explore cognitive and physical limits, achieving high-speed performance and 88.3% interaction success in simulated racing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种以世界模型为中心的自主赛车智能体，从接近极限的真实车辆数据中学习预测性世界模型，以共同探索认知和物理极限，在模拟赛车中实现了高速性能和88.3%的交互成功率。
summary_zh: 具身人工智能旨在开发能够通过与物理世界持续交互来感知、推理和行动的智能体。然而，当前多数具身系统仍仅在保守的安全裕度或中等交互模式下进行评估，导致其在极端条件下的能力边界尚未得到充分理解。自动驾驶赛车通过融合高频定位与感知、对抗性交互、近饱和车辆动力学及严格安全约束，提供了一个严苛的测试平台。现有系统虽能实现高速性能，却鲜有对认知与物理极限进行联合建模与优化。在此，我们展示了一种以世界模型为核心的自动驾驶赛车智能体，为探索这类耦合极限提供了具体路径。该框架从近极限状态的成败经验中学习预测性世界模型，以捕捉交互演化、自车动力学及可行运动边界，并通过闭环优化过程耦合世界状态构建、前瞻性推理与近极限控制。训练数据采集自真实车辆自动驾驶赛事实测，车载系统在时速高达256.3公里、峰值横向加速度达26.8米/秒²的条件下保持稳定的定位与感知能力。在全尺寸仿真竞赛中，经过充分训练的以世界模型为核心的智能体在多种具有挑战性的模拟赛场景下实现了88.3%的交互成功率。世界模型与策略的闭环优化进一步提升了认知-物理极限的利用率、故障模式的恢复能力，以及不同工况与未知赛道的泛化能力。这些结果表明，一种基于边界感知的方法学正逐步成形：世界模型可帮助具身智能体表征、预测并持续优化其能力边界，从而实现更安全的现实世界部署。

title: BooST: Bridging Semantics and Motions for Efficient Skill Transfer
summary: Skill abstraction---the process of learning reusable and temporally extended behaviors---has emerged as a key paradigm for improving sample efficiency and generalization in robot learning. For efficient skill transfer to real robots, learned skills must generalize across tasks and domains, remain robust to visual and dynamic perturbations, and be efficient enough for practical deployment. However, existing methods typically satisfy only a subset of these properties, as they capture either high-level semantic intent (what) or low-level motion dynamics (how). This incomplete skill transfer yields weak priors for policy learning, thereby demanding substantial in-domain data for downstream adaptation. To address these challenges, we introduce BooST, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges semantics and motions to satisfy all three desiderata. BooST first leverages a cross-modal VQ-VAE to capture both semantic intent and motion dynamics, yielding a unified skill representation. It then distills this representation into a lightweight policy for efficient downstream adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments across simulation and real-robot settings demonstrate that BooST achieves superior few-shot adaptation, cross-domain skill transfer, and robustness to dynamic visual distractors, while maintaining a lightweight yet expressive design suitable for real-world deployment.
tldr: BooST is a two-stage framework that uses a cross-modal VQ-VAE to learn unified skill representations bridging semantics and motions, then distills them into a lightweight policy for efficient few-shot adaptation and cross-domain transfer on real robots.
tldr_zh: BooST 是一个两阶段框架，通过跨模态 VQ-VAE 学习融合语义与运动的统一技能表征，并蒸馏为轻量级策略，实现真实机器人的高效少样本适应与跨域迁移。
summary_zh: 技能抽象——即学习可复用且具有时间延展性行为的过程——已成为提升机器人学习样本效率与泛化能力的关键范式。为实现向真实机器人的高效技能迁移，所学技能需具备跨任务与跨领域的泛化能力、对视觉与动力学扰动的鲁棒性，并达到实际部署所需的效率水平。然而，现有方法通常仅满足上述部分特性，因其要么捕捉高层语义意图（"做什么"），要么聚焦底层运动动力学（"如何做"）。这种不完整的技能迁移导致策略学习的先验知识薄弱，从而需要大量领域内数据进行下游适配。为解决这些挑战，我们提出BooST——一种明确桥接语义与运动的两阶段框架，以满足全部三项需求指标。BooST首先利用跨模态VQ-VAE同时捕获语义意图与运动动力学，形成统一的技能表征；随后将该表征蒸馏为轻量级策略，以实现对新任务的高效下游适配。跨仿真环境与真实机器人平台的广泛实验表明，BooST在保持适用于实际部署的轻量化与高表达能力设计的同时，实现了卓越的小样本适配能力、跨域技能迁移能力以及对动态视觉干扰的鲁棒性。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Diffusion-Based Unrestricted Robotic Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in controlling robots across diverse manipulation tasks. However, their adversarial robustness remains largely underexplored, and exploiting this weakness can lead to physical-world harm. Existing attacks on VLA models often rely on pixel-space perturbations or white-box access, resulting in noticeable artifacts and limited deployability in real-world robotic systems. In this work, we propose DURA, a diffusion-based unrestricted robotic attack that generates visually natural adversarial patches for VLA models. DURA supports both white-box and black-box attack settings, where the black-box setting requires only the predicted actions of the victim model. By optimizing along the latent trajectory of a pretrained diffusion model, DURA generates visually natural patches while steering the robot toward attacker-specified target actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and the real physical world show that DURA consistently outperforms existing methods. Our findings expose a safety risk for physically deployed VLA models and call for stronger defenses.
tldr: Proposes DURA, a diffusion-based unrestricted adversarial attack that generates natural adversarial patches to fool VLA models in both white-box and black-box settings, exposing safety risks in real-world robotic deployments.
tldr_zh: 提出DURA，一种基于扩散模型的无限制对抗攻击方法，能在白盒和黑盒设置下生成自然的对抗补丁，欺骗VLA模型，暴露真实机器人部署中的安全风险。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在跨多种操作任务中控制机器人方面展现出强大能力。然而，其对抗鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，利用这一弱点可能导致物理世界中的危害。现有的VLA模型攻击方法往往依赖像素空间扰动或白盒访问，导致明显的伪影，且在实际机器人系统中部署受限。在本工作中，我们提出DURA——一种基于扩散的无限制机器人攻击方法，能够为VLA模型生成视觉自然的对抗补丁。DURA同时支持白盒和黑盒攻击设置，其中黑盒设置仅需受害模型预测的动作。通过沿预训练扩散模型的潜在轨迹进行优化，DURA在引导机器人趋向攻击者指定目标动作的同时，生成视觉自然的补丁。在仿真与真实物理世界中的大量实验表明，DURA持续优于现有方法。我们的发现揭示了物理部署的VLA模型所面临的安全风险，并呼吁建立更强的防御机制。

title: Dreamer-SAC: Off-Policy Learning in Latent World Models for Sample-Efficient Autonomous Driving
summary: Sample-efficient reinforcement learning for autonomous driving is often limited by the trade-off between data efficiency and model bias. While world models reduce the reliance on costly environment interactions, policy optimization over learned dynamics remains sensitive to prediction errors. This paper proposes the Dreamer-SAC framework, which integrates a recurrent state-space world model with an off-policy soft actor-critic algorithm trained directly in latent space. The framework uses a combination of real interactions and short-horizon generated trajectories with n-step target estimation and multi-objective supervision. Evaluated in autonomous driving scenarios with objectives encompassing driving efficiency and safety, the proposed framework consistently outperforms representative reinforcement learning baselines, including DreamerV3, SAC, and PPO, while achieving improved performance with substantially fewer real environment interactions. Experiments reveal an inverted-U relationship between rollout horizon and policy performance, where short-horizon latent rollouts achieve the best trade-off between additional training signals and accumulated model bias. Furthermore, n-step target estimation demonstrates more effectiveness over one-step temporal-difference targets in exploiting predicted experience for value learning.
tldr: Dreamer-SAC integrates a recurrent state-space world model with an off-policy soft actor-critic algorithm trained in latent space, using short-horizon rollouts and n-step targets to achieve sample-efficient autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: Dreamer-SAC 将递归状态空间世界模型与在潜在空间中训练的离策略软演员-评论家算法结合，通过短视界展开和 n 步目标实现样本高效的自动驾驶。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
面向自动驾驶的样本高效强化学习通常受限于数据效率与模型偏差之间的权衡。尽管世界模型减少了对昂贵环境交互的依赖，但基于学习到的动力学进行策略优化时仍对预测误差敏感。本文提出Dreamer-SAC框架，该框架将循环状态空间世界模型与直接在潜在空间中训练的离策略软演员-评论家算法相结合。该框架结合了真实交互与短视距生成轨迹，并采用n步目标估计与多目标监督。在兼顾驾驶效率与安全性的自动驾驶场景中进行评估，所提框架持续优于包括DreamerV3、SAC和PPO在内的代表性强化学习基线，且在显著减少真实环境交互次数的前提下实现了更优性能。实验揭示滚动视距与策略性能之间存在倒U型关系，其中短视距潜在滚动在额外训练信号与累积模型偏差之间取得了最佳权衡。此外，在利用预测经验进行价值学习方面，n步目标估计比一步时序差分目标更为有效。

title: Real-World Cooperative Bimanual Dexterous Grasp of Large Objects from Single-View Observations
summary: Bimanual dexterous grasping of large objects is a critical challenge in robotic manipulation. However, most existing studies focus on sequential manipulation rather than cooperative grasping, and methods addressing such bimanual tasks have largely been limited to simulation. These limitations stem from the difficulty of acquiring full 3D object models and generating physically plausible grasping actions. To fill this gap, we propose a real-world bimanual grasping framework that includes: a multimodal dataset capturing joint angles, visual observations and force signals; a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based module that generates joint-level grasp configurations from segmented point clouds; and an execution strategy that integrates motion planning with online grasp refinement to ensure physical stability and feasibility. Our approach enables the synthesis of executable bimanual grasps from single-view inputs, reducing dependence on complete 3D object models and ensuring stable real-world performance. Experiments on a dual-arm robot demonstrate high success rates across unseen objects with varying geometries and poses, and ablation studies confirm the contributions of key components of our system.
tldr: This paper proposes a real-world bimanual dexterous grasping framework that uses a DDPM module to generate joint-level grasp configurations from single-view point clouds, enabling cooperative grasping of large objects without full 3D models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一套真实世界的双臂灵巧抓取框架，利用DDPM模块从单视角点云生成关节级抓取配置，无需完整3D模型即可实现大物体的合作抓取。
summary_zh: 双手灵巧抓取大型物体是机器人操作领域的一项关键挑战。然而，现有研究大多侧重于顺序操作而非协同抓取，且针对此类双手任务的方法主要局限于仿真环境。这些局限性源于获取完整3D物体模型及生成符合物理规律的抓取动作的困难。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种面向真实世界的双手抓取框架，包含：一个记录关节角度、视觉观测与力信号的多模态数据集；一个基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的模块，可从分割点云生成关节级抓取构型；以及一种集成运动规划与在线抓取优化的执行策略，以确保物理稳定性与可行性。我们的方法能够从单视角输入合成可执行的双手抓取，减少了对完整3D物体模型的依赖，并保证了稳定的真实世界性能。在双臂机器人上的实验表明，该方法对具有不同几何形状与姿态的未见物体均具有高成功率，而消融研究验证了系统关键组件的贡献。

title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
summary: Recent world-action models (WAMs) show that co-training policies with future prediction can provide physical priors for action generation. Building on the future-prediction ability of video models, many WAMs generate future videos and recover actions with inverse-dynamics models, or use these predicted videos as goal conditions for action generation. In both cases, the world model is trained mostly on successful demonstrations and has little reason to predict the consequences of bad actions. We introduce FACT, a causal World-Action Model that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on the executed action. This action-conditioned interface allows failure rollouts to supervise action consequences, turning bad actions into valid future targets rather than being discarded. Failure-aware training makes the progress predictor aware of both successful and failed action outcomes, which can optionally be used to score sampled action candidates at inference. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that FACT outperforms many existing baselines, improves as failure data are incorporated into training, and reduces success-biased future hallucination under bad actions. See more details at https://fact-wam.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces FACT, a failure-aware causal world-action model that trains on both successful and failed demonstrations to improve future video prediction and task progress estimation for bimanual manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FACT，一种故障感知因果世界-动作模型，通过同时利用成功和失败演示进行训练，以改善双手操控任务中的未来视频预测和任务进度估计。
summary_zh: 近期，世界动作模型（WAMs）的研究表明，将联合训练策略与未来预测相结合，能为动作生成提供物理先验知识。基于视频模型的未来预测能力，许多WAMs通过逆动力学模型生成未来视频并恢复动作，或将这些预测视频作为动作生成的目标条件。在这两种情形下，世界模型主要依靠成功演示进行训练，几乎没有理由预测不良动作的后果。我们提出FACT——一种因果世界-动作模型，该模型根据已执行的动作预测未来视频与任务进展。这种以动作为条件的接口使失败轨迹能够监督动作后果，将不良动作转化为有效的未来目标而非直接舍弃。失败感知训练使进度预测器同时感知到成功与失败的动作结果，在推理时可选择性地用于对采样的候选动作进行评分。在仿真和真实双臂操作任务上的大量实验表明，FACT的表现优于许多现有基线方法，随着失败数据被纳入训练而性能不断提升，并减少了在不良动作下产生成功偏置的未来幻觉。更多细节请参见https://fact-wam.github.io/。

title: Threat-guided Policy-aware Scene Perturbation for Safe Autonomous Driving with Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promising performance in autonomous driving, yet ensuring the safety of online RL policies remains challenging due to insufficient exposure to safety-critical driving scenes. The long-tailed nature of real-world traffic situations makes dangerous and rare interactions difficult to encounter through conventional sampling, limiting the ability of RL policies to learn robust safety behaviors. Existing methods improve training diversity by synthesizing challenging scenes or adversarial situations. However, these approaches typically optimize scene generation objectives separately from the evolving policy, without explicitly modeling how generated perturbations relate to the current policy's weaknesses and learning needs. In this paper, we propose Threat-guided Policy-aware Scene Perturbation (TPSP) for safe autonomous driving with online RL. TPSP introduces a policy-aware scene encoder to capture the interaction between policy behaviors and surrounding environments, enabling scene perturbation aligned with the current policy. Based on this representation, TPSP selectively perturbs critical objects rather than applying uniform modifications across the scene. Furthermore, we develop a threat-guided optimization strategy that evaluates perturbed scenes through threat-level differences between policy rollouts on original and perturbed scenes, guiding the generation of safety-critical scenes with higher training value. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that TPSP improves safety learning efficiency, achieving strong safety performance on NAVSIM v2 with approximately 4 million kilometers of simulated driving data. Ablation studies verify that policy-aware targeted perturbations provide more informative safety-critical experiences than random or policy-unaware strategies, enabling safer driving under limited interaction budgets.
tldr: This paper proposes Threat-guided Policy-aware Scene Perturbation (TPSP), a method that generates safety-critical driving scenes by modeling the interaction between the RL policy and traffic participants to improve safe online reinforcement learning for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出威胁引导的策略感知场景扰动方法（TPSP），通过建模强化学习策略与交通参与者之间的交互来生成安全关键的驾驶场景，以提升自动驾驶在线强化学习的安全性。
summary_zh: 强化学习在自动驾驶领域展现出良好前景，但由于缺乏对安全关键驾驶场景的充分暴露，在线强化学习策略的安全性保障仍面临挑战。现实交通情境的长尾特性使得危险且罕见的交互难以通过常规采样方式获得，限制了强化学习策略学习鲁棒安全行为的能力。现有方法通过合成挑战性场景或对抗情境来提升训练多样性，但这些方法通常将场景生成目标与演化策略分离优化，未能显式建模生成扰动与当前策略弱点及学习需求之间的关联。本文提出面向在线强化学习安全驾驶的威胁引导策略感知场景扰动方法（TPSP）。TPSP引入策略感知场景编码器，捕捉策略行为与周围环境之间的交互，使场景扰动与当前策略对齐。基于该表征，TPSP选择性地扰动关键对象，而非对场景进行统一修改。此外，我们开发了威胁引导优化策略，通过原始场景与扰动场景中策略推演的威胁等级差异评估扰动场景，从而引导生成训练价值更高的安全关键场景。综合实验表明，TPSP提升了安全学习效率，在约400万公里模拟驾驶数据的NAVSIM v2上实现了强劲的安全性能。消融研究验证了策略感知的针对性扰动相较于随机或策略无关策略，能够提供更具信息量的安全关键经验，从而在有限交互预算下实现更安全的驾驶。

title: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
summary: Learning reliable surgical manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of action-labeled demonstrations: teleoperated surgical robot (e.g., dVRK) trajectories with synchronized kinematics are costly to collect, while surgical tasks demand precise contact handling, long-horizon reasoning, and bimanual coordination. Endoscopic video is comparatively inexpensive and abundant relative to synchronized video--kinematics trajectories, and a natural way to exploit it is to learn world models of surgical scenes. However, existing surgical world models use video primarily for simulation or policy evaluation, and rarely translate the learned dynamics into closed-loop control. This gap raises our central question: under a fixed budget of action-labeled demonstrations, does action-free video pretraining improve closed-loop surgical manipulation? To answer it, we introduce the Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM), a unified generative model built on Cosmos Policy that jointly predicts future endoscopic observations and executable surgical robot action chunks. Surgical WAM first learns surgical visual dynamics from action-free video and is then fine-tuned on the fixed action-labeled budget; at deployment, it acts as a closed-loop, receding-horizon controller that executes a short prefix of each predicted action chunk and replans from the resulting observation. On a suite of four simulated surgical manipulation tasks, video pretraining improves the average success rate from 63.5% to 77.8%, including an absolute gain of 20 percentage points on PegTransfer, with the largest improvements on contact-rich and bimanual tasks. These results demonstrate that action-free video provides transferable visual dynamics priors for learning surgical robot control with limited action supervision, positioning data-efficient video pretraining as a practical path toward scaling up surgical robot learning.
tldr: Surgical WAM is a world-action model that uses action-free video pretraining to learn visual dynamics priors for data-efficient closed-loop surgical robot control, achieving significant success rate improvements on simulated bimanual and contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: Surgical WAM是一个世界动作模型，通过无动作视频预训练学习视觉动态先验，实现数据高效的闭环手术机器人控制，在模拟双臂和接触密集任务上显著提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 学习可靠的外科操作策略受限于带有动作标签的演示数据的稀缺性：通过遥操作手术机器人（例如 dVRK）采集的同步运动学轨迹成本高昂，而外科任务要求精确的接触处理、长时程推理和双臂协调。相比之下，内窥镜视频相对于同步视频-运动学轨迹而言成本较低且数据量丰富，利用它的自然途径是学习手术场景的世界模型。然而，现有的手术世界模型主要将视频用于仿真或策略评估，很少将学到的动力学知识转化为闭环控制。这一差距引出了我们的核心问题：在固定预算的动作标签演示数据下，无动作视频预训练能否改善闭环手术操作？为回答该问题，我们提出了手术世界-动作模型（Surgical WAM），这是一个基于 Cosmos Policy 构建的统一生成模型，可同时预测未来的内窥镜观测结果和可执行的手术机器人动作块。Surgical WAM 首先从无动作视频中学习手术视觉动力学，然后在固定的动作标签预算下进行微调；在部署时，它作为一个闭环、滚动时域控制器，执行每个预测动作块的前缀短片段，并根据反馈的观测结果重新规划。在一组四个模拟手术操作任务中，视频预训练将平均成功率从 63.5% 提升至 77.8%，其中在 PegTransfer 任务上绝对提升达 20 个百分点，且在接触密集型和双臂协调任务上改进最为显著。这些结果表明，在有限动作监督下，无动作视频为学习手术机器人控制提供了可迁移的视觉动力学先验知识，将数据高效的视频预训练定位为扩展手术机器人学习规模的实用途径。

title: Risk-Aware Kinodynamic Motion Planning Under Uncertainty For Safe Navigation on Planetary Environments
summary: For autonomous space exploration, robotic agents need to perform motion planning in which environmental interactions may be unknown. Learning these interactions, such as terrain mechanics for wheeled robots, can introduce uncertainties that lead to risky motion plans and potentially hazardous operations or mission failures. Moreover, uncertainties induced by perception-based systems can exacerbate the problem of safe motion planning. In this letter, we address the problem of performing cost-optimal kinodynamic motion planning with risk awareness. We approach this in two steps. First, a sampling-based planner (AO-RRT) generates a dynamically feasible, risk-aware, and asymptotically cost-optimal trajectory. Second, we formulate motion planning as a nonlinear optimization problem and solve it using sequential convex programming (SCP), using the AO-RRT trajectory as an initial solution. By quantifying risk using conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), we demonstrate a reduction in risk by over $\sim$97\% across trajectories in simulation and hardware experiments.
tldr: This paper proposes a risk-aware kinodynamic motion planning method for planetary exploration robots, combining a sampling-based planner with nonlinear optimization to reduce path risk by over 97% using CVaR.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种面向行星探测机器人的风险感知动力学运动规划方法，结合采样规划器与非线性优化，利用条件风险价值将路径风险降低超过97%。
summary_zh: 在自主空间探索中，机器人代理需要执行运动规划，而环境交互可能具有未知性。学习这些交互（例如轮式机器人的地形力学）会引入不确定性，可能导致冒险的运动规划、潜在的危险操作或任务失败。此外，基于感知系统引发的不确定性会加剧安全运动规划的问题。本文旨在解决具有风险意识的最优代价运动动力学规划问题。我们分两步实现这一目标：首先，基于采样的规划器（AO-RRT）生成动态可行、具有风险意识且渐进代价最优的轨迹；其次，我们将运动规划表述为非线性优化问题，并采用序列凸规划（SCP）方法求解，以AO-RRT轨迹作为初始解。通过使用条件风险价值（CVaR）量化风险，我们在仿真和硬件实验中证明了轨迹风险降低超过约97%。

title: VIScore: Diagnosing Planning-Relevant Quality in Latent World Models
summary: Regulating the latent space to an isotropic Gaussian distribution provides a stable and information-maximized landscape for world model planning. However, the latent space property and successful planning remain disconnected. We first study this by comparing SIGReg and VISReg, two regularization loss functions with the same distribution target but different properties. Compared with SIGReg, VISReg has more flexibility in controlling the weights of center, scale, and shape regularization, and a larger batch size brings a finer distribution approximation. We find that the former, despite being beneficial in self-supervised learning (SSL), does not help the planning, whereas the latter improves the planning success on out-of-domain (OOD) datasets. This motivates a deep understanding of the factors that correlate with the success rate. Unlike the previous metrics focusing on the encoded latent only, we propose the Veracity-Influence-Sobriety score (VIScore), a metric that quantifies the reachability and capacity of a predictor given the encoded feature, and the hallucination of the searching-based planner. Compared with straightness, physical-state probing, and empowerment, we show that, with the measurement covering encoder, predictor, and planner, VIScore explains the success rate better than the others, as reflected by a strong Spearman correlation. Specifically, VIScore consistently achieves a Spearman correlation over 0.75 on both seen and unseen models and datasets on the cross-task success rate pool. Moreover, VIScore is the only metric that has a calibration error below the constant fit across all testing scenarios, showcasing the importance of these three aspects in planning success. We hope this metric can help future studies on world model design and diagnosis.
tldr: This paper introduces VIScore, a metric that evaluates the quality of latent world models for planning by measuring reachability, capacity, and hallucination, showing strong correlation with planning success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VIScore，一种通过评估可达性、容量和幻觉来衡量潜在世界模型规划质量的指标，与规划成功率具有强相关性。
summary_zh: 将潜空间约束为各向同性高斯分布，为世界模型规划提供了稳定且信息最大化的空间。然而，潜空间特性与成功规划之间仍存在割裂。我们首先通过对比SIGReg和VISReg这两种具有相同分布目标但特性不同的正则化损失函数来研究这一问题。与SIGReg相比，VISReg在控制中心、尺度与形状正则化的权重方面具有更高灵活性，且更大的批量能带来更精细的分布逼近。研究发现：前者尽管在自监督学习中表现有益，却无助于规划；而后者则提升了面向域外数据集的规划成功率。这一发现促使我们深入理解与成功率相关的因素。与以往仅关注编码潜变量的指标不同，我们提出了真实性-影响力-清醒度评分——一种量化给定编码特征下预测器的可达性、容量以及基于搜索的规划器幻觉程度的指标。与直线性、物理状态探测和赋能指标相比，我们展示了覆盖编码器、预测器和规划器的VIScore能更好地解释成功率，这通过强斯皮尔曼相关性得以体现。具体而言，在跨任务成功率池的已知与未知模型及数据集上，VIScore始终能达到0.75以上的斯皮尔曼相关性。此外，在所有测试场景中，VIScore是唯一校准误差低于常数拟合的指标，凸显了这三个方面在规划成功中的重要性。我们希望该指标能助力未来世界模型设计与诊断的相关研究。

title: Aerial Layouting: Design and Control of a Compliant and Actuated End-Effector for Precise In-flight Marking on Ceilings
summary: Aerial robots have demonstrated impressive feats of precise control, such as dynamic flight through openings or highly complex choreographies. Despite the accuracy needed for these tasks, there are problems that require levels of precision that are challenging to achieve today. One such problem is aerial interaction. Advances in aerial robot design and control have made such contact-based tasks possible and opened up research into challenging real-world tasks, including contact-based inspection. However, while centimetre accuracy is sufficient and achievable for inspection tasks, the positioning accuracy needed for other problems, such as layouting on construction sites or general push-and-slide tasks, is millimetres. To achieve such a high precision, we propose a new aerial system composed of an aerial vehicle equipped with a novel "smart" end-effector leveraging a stability-optimized Gough-Stewart mechanism. We present its design process and features incorporating the principles of compliance, multiple contact points, actuation, and self-containment. In experiments, we verify that the design choices made for our novel end-effector are necessary to obtain the desired positioning precision. Furthermore, we demonstrate that we can reliably mark lines on ceilings with millimetre accuracy without the need for precise modeling or sophisticated control of the aerial robot.
tldr: This paper presents a novel compliant and actuated end-effector for aerial robots, enabling millimeter-precise in-flight marking on ceilings without requiring precise modeling or sophisticated control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型的兼容且可驱动的末端执行器，用于空中机器人，实现了无需精确建模或复杂控制即可在空中进行毫米级精确的天花板划线。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
空中机器人在精确控制方面已展现出令人瞩目的成就，例如通过动态飞行穿越狭小开口或完成极其复杂的编队动作。尽管这些任务所需精度极高，但当前仍存在一些需要更高精度水平、实现难度极大的问题，空中交互便是其中之一。空中机器人设计与控制的进步使此类基于接触的任务成为可能，并推动了接触式检测等具有挑战性的现实应用研究。然而，虽然厘米级精度已足以满足并实现检测任务，但诸如建筑工地放线或常规推滑操作等其他问题所需的定位精度需达到毫米级。为实现如此高的精度，我们提出了一套新型空中系统，该系统由配备创新型"智能"末端执行器的飞行器构成，该执行器采用稳定性优化的Gough-Stewart机构。我们阐述了其设计流程与特性，融合了柔顺性、多点接触、驱动及自包含等设计原则。实验结果表明，为新型末端执行器所做的设计选择是实现所需定位精度的必要条件。此外，我们验证了无需对空中机器人进行精确建模或复杂控制，即可在天花板上以毫米级精度可靠完成线路标记。

title: Enabling Scalable Kinesthetic Teaching via Observer-based Hand-guiding with Active Support
summary: Kinesthetic teaching through robot hand-guiding provides a natural interface for collecting demonstrations in imitation learning and programming-by-demonstration. However, extended sessions cause operator fatigue, reducing demonstration quality and limiting scalability. Current industrial hand-guiding approaches typically provide no active assistance, and alternatives require costly wrist-mounted force-torque sensors or rely on learned motion priors unavailable for new tasks. We propose RHOAS, a hand-guiding scheme that actively supports operator-intended motions using model-based force estimation without additional hardware. Our approach considers robot hand-guiding as an actively controlled interaction by the human operator, rather than an interaction with a passive environment. Standard methods used for hand-guiding typically rely on general passivity-based compliant control architectures that unnecessarily increase operator effort and limit the range of demonstrable motions without providing the intended stability guarantees in active interaction. Instead, our design utilizes model-based external torque estimation, internal joint torque sensing, and redundant robot kinematics to actively support human physical input within the human interaction frequency bandwidth. We address practical challenges of relying on observer-based force estimation, including suppression of unmodeled joint elastic dynamic effects and measurement noise in the feedback path, reduced estimate accuracy close to kinematic singularities, and static gravity compensation errors. In a user study with 16 participants on a KUKA LWR iiwa we demonstrate statistically significant reductions in physical effort, improved maneuverability for both precise and agile tasks, and clear user preference.
tldr: This paper proposes RHOAS, a hand-guiding scheme for kinesthetic teaching that actively supports operator-intended motions using model-based force estimation without additional hardware, significantly reducing physical effort and improving maneuverability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RHOAS，一种基于模型力估计的主动支持操作者意图运动的机器人手引导方案，无需额外硬件，显著降低体力消耗并提高操作灵活性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
通过机器人手把手引导进行的动觉教学，为模仿学习和编程示范中的示范数据收集提供了自然交互方式。然而，长时间操作会导致操作者疲劳，降低示范质量并限制可扩展性。当前的工业手把手引导方法通常不提供主动辅助，而替代方案则需要昂贵的腕部力-力矩传感器，或依赖于无法用于新任务的学习型运动先验。我们提出RHOAS——一种无需额外硬件、通过基于模型的力估计主动支持操作者意图运动的手把手引导方案。该方法将机器人手把手引导视为人类操作者的主动控制交互，而非与被动环境的交互。标准手把手引导方法通常采用基于通用被动性的柔顺控制架构，这些架构不必要地增加了操作者的负担，限制了可演示运动的范围，且无法在主动交互中提供预期的稳定性保障。相反，我们的设计利用基于模型的外部力矩估计、内部关节力矩传感以及冗余机器人运动学，在人类交互频率带宽内主动支持人体物理输入。我们解决了依赖基于观测器的力估计所面临的实践挑战，包括抑制反馈路径中未建模的关节弹性动态效应与测量噪声、接近运动学奇异点时估计精度下降，以及静态重力补偿误差。在16名参与者使用KUKA LWR iiwa的用户研究中，我们证明了该方法在物理负荷上具有统计显著性降低，可同时提升精确任务与灵活任务的操控性，且用户偏好明确。

title: Hip Energized Monopedal Hopping
summary: We present a novel stepping strategy for pitch unlocked planar monopeds where the reaction torques from stabilizing pitch with a conventional PD + feedfoward controller are recruited to counteract energetic losses from damping. By moving the location of the mass center, our controller increases the pitch stabilization torque, thereby adding energy to the gait. A new stepping policy adjusts the distribution of energy between the radial and angular degrees of freedom to counteract dissipative losses and achieve a user specified balance between steady state fore-aft speed and apex height. Hybrid averaging analysis yields closed form expressions for the fixed points and eigenvalues of the resulting gait, lending insight into the interplay between the physical and control parameters' influence on performance. Simulation studies on a generic 5 link biped and a careful model of the Penn Jerboa reveal a useful correspondence to these analytical predictions. Physical experiments on the Penn Jerboa exhibit stable locomotion with speeds ranging from 1.02 m/s to 1.77 m/s (5.10 leg lengths/s to 8.85 leg lengths/s) in a manner effectively approximated by the mathematical analysis.
tldr: This paper presents a novel stepping strategy for pitch-unlocked planar monopeds that uses pitch stabilization torque to counteract energy losses, achieving stable, high-speed hopping on the Penn Jerboa robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种针对俯仰未锁定平面单足机器人的新颖步态策略，利用俯仰稳定力矩抵消能量损失，在Penn Jerboa机器人上实现了稳定、高速的跳跃运动。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
本文提出了一种适用于俯仰未锁定平面单足机器人的新型步进策略，该策略利用传统PD+前馈控制器在俯仰稳定过程中产生的反作用力矩来抵消阻尼带来的能量损失。通过改变质心位置，控制器增大了俯仰稳定力矩，从而为步态补充能量。一种新的步进策略能够调节径向与角自由度之间的能量分配，以抵消耗散损失，并实现用户指定的稳态前后速度与顶点高度之间的平衡。混合平均分析得到了步态固定点与特征值的闭式表达式，揭示了物理参数与控制参数对性能影响的相互作用机制。针对通用五连杆双足机器人的仿真研究以及对Penn Jerboa机器人的精细建模，均显示出与这些理论分析结果的高度一致性。在Penn Jerboa实物实验中，机器人实现了1.02米/秒至1.77米/秒（即5.10腿长/秒至8.85腿长/秒）的稳定运动，且运动特性与数学模型分析结果高度吻合。

title: Whole-Body Planning for Humanoids Navigating Confined Spaces via Self-Collision Avoidance References
summary: Humanoid locomotion in highly confined environments requires navigating dense environmental obstacles and complex self-collision bounds while maintaining multi-contact dynamic feasibility. Traditional trajectory optimizers frequently struggle in these restricted spaces, as navigating the large collision space with splines on particle abstractions is insufficient and leads to poor local minima. To address this, we propose a three-stage whole-body planning framework that formulates kinematic path planning directly over kinematically reachable rigid-body volumes. By integrating differentiable collision avoidance into a reachability-constrained formulation, our framework synthesizes volume-informed guides that reliably guide a full-order trajectory optimizer over long horizons. We show that these optimized plans serve as high-quality references to train a residual reinforcement learning policy for robust online execution. We validate our approach on the Unitree G1 humanoid across three benchmark testbeds exceeding NIST emergency response standards, achieving restricted confinement ratios ($C_r < 1.5$). Our framework generates feasible trajectories across 12-to-18-second tasks with complex foot and hand contacts where standard baselines fail, while the learned policy successfully tracks these plans under extensive domain randomization in physics simulation.
tldr: A three-stage whole-body planning framework for humanoid robots to navigate confined spaces via differentiable self-collision avoidance and volume-informed guides, validated on Unitree G1 in simulation.
tldr_zh: 一个针对人形机器人在狭小空间导航的三阶段全身规划框架，通过可微自碰撞避免和体积信息引导实现，在Unitree G1仿真中验证。
summary_zh: 高度受限环境下的人形机器人运动，需要在满足多接触动态可行性的同时，穿越密集的环境障碍并处理复杂的自碰撞约束。传统轨迹优化器在这些受限空间中常面临困境，因为基于质点抽象的样条曲线难以处理庞大的碰撞空间，并容易陷入较差的局部最优解。为此，我们提出了一种三阶段全身规划框架，该框架直接在运动学可达的刚体空间上构建运动学路径规划。通过将可微碰撞避免融入可达性约束的公式化表达，该框架能够生成富含体积信息的引导路径，从而可靠地引导全阶轨迹优化器进行长时域规划。我们证明，这些优化后的规划可作为高质量参考，用于训练残差强化学习策略以实现在线的鲁棒执行。我们在三个超过NIST应急响应标准的基准测试平台上，使用Unitree G1人形机器人验证了该方法，实现了受限空间比（$C_r < 1.5$）。该框架在标准基线方法无法完成的12至18秒复杂任务中生成了可行轨迹，并涉及复杂的脚部与手部接触，同时学习到的策略在物理仿真的广泛域随机化下成功完成了对这些规划轨迹的跟踪。

title: Cross-View Sequential Visual Localization with Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Continuous and reliable localization is essential for autonomous driving. Cross-view visual localization matches ground images with satellite maps, providing complementary localization cues for pipelines that depend on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals and high-definition (HD) maps. Most existing cross-view visual localization methods process each frame independently, leaving temporal information underused and limiting accuracy under dynamic occlusion, illumination variation, and repetitive textures. This study proposes a temporal-context-enhanced framework for cross-view sequence visual localization. The proposed recurrent cross-frame module aggregates historical context from the previous state to enhance the coarse ground feature of each current frame. These enhanced features facilitate satellite candidate-region classification, while hierarchical fine-grained features enable precise local offset estimation. On the CVIS dataset, the proposed method reduces mean localization error from 3.80 m to 1.57 m and increases R@1 m from 8.14% to 40.22%. Direct transfer to KITTI-CVL achieves a mean error of 2.61 m, with target-domain fine-tuning further reducing the mean error to 2.27 m. Zero-shot field experiments on a real-world vehicle achieve a mean error of 2.84 m and R@5 m of 96.86%. These results demonstrate that temporal context enhancement significantly improves cross-view localization accuracy and supports robust deployment on public benchmarks and real-world roads.
tldr: This paper proposes a temporal-context-enhanced framework for cross-view sequential visual localization in autonomous driving, using a recurrent cross-frame module to aggregate historical context and improve accuracy over single-frame methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的跨视角序列视觉定位框架，通过循环跨帧模块聚合历史上下文信息，相比单帧方法显著提升了定位精度。
summary_zh: 连续且可靠的定位对于自动驾驶至关重要。跨视角视觉定位通过将地面图像与卫星地图进行匹配，为依赖全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）信号和高清（HD）地图的定位管道提供互补的定位线索。现有的大多数跨视角视觉定位方法独立处理每一帧，导致时间信息未被充分利用，且在动态遮挡、光照变化和重复纹理场景下精度受限。本研究提出了一种时间上下文增强的跨视角序列视觉定位框架。所提出的循环跨帧模块通过聚合前一状态的历史上下文信息，增强当前每一帧的粗略地面特征。这些增强后的特征有助于卫星候选区域分类，而分层细粒度特征则能实现精确的局部偏移估计。在CVIS数据集上，所提方法将平均定位误差从3.80米降低至1.57米，R@1米指标从8.14%提升至40.22%。直接迁移至KITTI-CVL数据集时平均误差为2.61米，经过目标域微调后平均误差进一步降至2.27米。在实车零样本现场实验中，平均误差为2.84米，R@5米指标达到96.86%。这些结果表明，时间上下文增强显著提升了跨视角定位精度，并支持在公开基准测试及真实道路场景中的稳健部署。

title: HUI360: A 360° Egocentric Dataset and Baselines for Human-Robot Interaction Anticipation
summary: As robots increasingly operate in human-populated environments, anticipating human intentions is essential for enabling proactive and socially aware behavior. Automatic anticipation of human-robot interactions is thus emerging as a crucial perception challenge for embodied agents. To this end, we introduce HUI360, the largest dataset for human-robot interaction anticipation in the wild and its set of baselines. The dataset was collected from a mobile robot, in the wild, over multiple days within a 3-month period, and in several environments, capturing natural, spontaneous behaviors from both passersby and users, and encompassing a diverse range of individuals. This variety enables evaluating and improving the generalization capabilities of interaction anticipation models. We designed a pipeline and share code for automatic interaction annotation in arbitrary 360-degree equirectangular videos, along with interfaces for manual refinement. Using this pipeline, we release the HUI360 open set of 1M pre-processed annotations, including detailed 2D poses, facial keypoints, and segmentation masks, obtained using state-of-the-art computer vision methods and manually curated to ensure high-quality tracking and interaction annotation. Additionally, we release the raw panoptic 360-degree images captured from the robot's egocentric viewpoint (on demand, for research purpose only in compliance with GDPR). Finally, we establish benchmark baselines for interaction anticipation, including the first cross-dataset evaluations for this task: to this end, we also release 6M annotations for another existing in-the-wild outdoor dataset collected from a mobile robot (SSUP-HRI). Dataset and code can be found at https://hucebot.github.io/hui360.
tldr: This paper introduces HUI360, the largest dataset for human-robot interaction anticipation, collected from a mobile robot in the wild, along with baselines and cross-dataset evaluations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了HUI360，这是最大的野外人类-机器人交互预测数据集，由移动机器人收集，并提供了基线方法和跨数据集评估。
summary_zh: 随着机器人在人类居住环境中的部署日益广泛，预判人类意图对于实现主动且具有社会意识的机器人行为至关重要。因此，自动预判人机交互正成为具身智能体面临的关键感知挑战。为此，我们提出HUI360——目前最大的野外场景人机交互预判数据集及其基线模型集。该数据集由移动机器人在三个月内多日于多个野外环境采集，捕捉了行人与用户的自然自发行为，涵盖多样化的个体群体。这种多样性使得评估与提升交互预判模型的泛化能力成为可能。我们设计了一套自动化标注流程并共享相关代码，支持对任意360度等距柱状投影视频进行交互自动标注，同时提供人工精修接口。基于此流程，我们发布了HUI360开放集，包含100万经过预处理的标注数据——采用前沿计算机视觉方法获取，并经人工核验以确保高质量跟踪与交互标注的详细2D姿态、面部关键点及分割掩码。此外，我们还将发布从机器人自我中心视角采集的原始全景360度图像（按需提供，仅限符合GDPR的研究用途）。最后，我们建立了交互预判的基准基线，包含该任务的首个跨数据集评估体系；为此，我们还额外发布了另一个来自移动机器人的野外户外数据集（SSUP-HRI）的600万标注数据。数据集及代码详见https://hucebot.github.io/hui360。

title: Chain of Spatial Thoughts: Modality-Agnostic Spatial Grounding for Vision Language Models
summary: Spatial understanding is fundamental to embodied intelligence, underpinning applications such as robotic manipulation, embodied navigation, and autonomous driving. Although recent vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on additional spatial encoders or architectural modifications during inference, increasing computational cost. We introduce Space Tokens, a lightweight, architecture-agnostic framework that equips VLMs with explicit continuous spatial representations without requiring additional inference-time modules. By distilling scene-level 3D geometry and object-centric spatial attributes into continuous latent tokens, our method enables these modalities to be directly incorporated into a chain-of-thought reasoning process, thereby improving the VLM's spatial reasoning capabilities. At the same time, the learned representations can be explicitly decoded to verify that they encode meaningful geometric information, while the unified token interface remains extensible to additional modalities. Experiments on VSI-Bench improve Qwen3-VL-8B by 4.3% and SenseNova-SI-1.3 by 1.3%, while achieving state-of-the-art performance on object size (79.2%) and room size estimation (75.7%). These results demonstrate that continuous spatial tokens provide an effective, interpretable, and computationally efficient mechanism for integrating geometric reasoning into large vision-language models.
tldr: This paper introduces Space Tokens, a lightweight, architecture-agnostic framework that distills 3D geometry and object attributes into continuous latent tokens for VLMs, improving spatial reasoning without extra inference modules.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Space Tokens，一种轻量级、架构无关的框架，将3D几何和物体属性蒸馏为连续潜在token，在不增加推理模块的情况下提升VLM的空间推理能力。
summary_zh: 空间理解是具身智能的基础，支撑着机器人操作、具身导航和自动驾驶等应用。尽管近期视觉-语言模型（VLM）在空间推理基准测试中取得了令人瞩目的性能，但最先进的方法通常依赖于推理过程中的额外空间编码器或架构修改，从而增加了计算成本。我们提出空间令牌（Space Tokens），这是一种轻量级、与架构无关的框架，能够为VLM配备显式的连续空间表示，而无需额外的推理模块。通过将场景级3D几何和以物体为中心的空间属性蒸馏为连续潜在令牌，我们的方法使这些模态能够直接融入思维链推理过程，从而提升VLM的空间推理能力。同时，学习到的表示可以被显式解码以验证其编码了有意义的几何信息，而统一的令牌接口仍可扩展至其他模态。在VSI-Bench上的实验表明，该方法使Qwen3-VL-8B提升了4.3%，SenseNova-SI-1.3提升了1.3%，并在物体大小估计（79.2%）和房间尺寸估计（75.7%）上取得了当前最优性能。这些结果表明，连续空间令牌为将几何推理集成到大型视觉-语言模型中提供了一种有效、可解释且计算高效的机制。

title: Deployment Is Not Destiny: Robot Recomposition in the Field with Unseen Software, Hardware, and Compute Payloads
summary: The tight coupling of subsystems in most robots, though a natural consequence of their complexity, leads to monolithic designs that are time-consuming and difficult to adapt after initial deployment. To address this challenge, we present a framework and supporting abstractions for recomposition during runtime that enable robots to quickly integrate previously unseen modular software, hardware, and compute payloads. Our approach allows non-expert users to quickly add new capabilities in the field through a true plug-and-play process. Crucially, new resources are not only immediately available to a host robot but are also shared with distributed peers, enabling compute-constrained systems to access powerful new remote capabilities. Our framework reduces reconfiguration time to a matter of minutes with no developer intervention, in stark contrast to the hours of expert effort often required for traditional manual integration. We demonstrate our method in two disaster response scenarios, including radioactive source localization at an operational nuclear reactor facility and a thermal-guided search for people in dark, difficult-to-reach spaces. These demonstrations show how in-field recomposition provides timely, flexible, and accessible adaptation to dynamic requirements, representing a critical step toward creating robots that can quickly evolve alongside the tasks, technologies, and environments they support.
tldr: This paper presents a framework for runtime recomposition of robots, allowing non-expert users to quickly integrate unseen software, hardware, and compute payloads in the field without developer intervention.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种机器人运行时重组的框架，使非专家用户能够在现场快速集成未见的软件、硬件和计算负载，无需开发人员干预。
summary_zh: 大多数机器人中子系统的紧密耦合，虽是其复杂性的自然结果，却导致了单体式设计，这使得机器人在初始部署后难以调整且改造耗时。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种支持运行时重组的框架及相应抽象机制，使机器人能够快速集成先前未见过的模块化软件、硬件及计算负载。我们的方法允许非专家用户通过真正的即插即用流程，在现场快速添加新功能。关键在于，新资源不仅可立即供主机机器人使用，还能与分布式对等节点共享，使计算受限的系统能够访问强大的远程新能力。该框架无需开发人员干预即可将重配置时间缩短至数分钟，这与传统手动集成通常需要专家耗费数小时形成鲜明对比。我们在两个灾难响应场景中验证了该方法，包括在运行中的核反应堆设施进行放射源定位，以及在黑暗难达空间开展热引导人员搜索。这些演示表明，现场重组能够为动态需求提供及时、灵活且易用的适配能力，这标志着在打造能够随其所支持的任务、技术和环境快速演进的机器人方面迈出了关键一步。

title: Dual Stress: Runtime Safety Monitoring for Safety-Constrained MPC Navigation
summary: Runtime hazard monitors for autonomous naviga- tion are conventionally built from geometric quantities: predicted clearance, time to collision, and required deceleration. A model-predictive controller that enforces safety through explicit con- straints computes, as a by-product of every control step, a second information channel that such monitors ignore: the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker multipliers of its constrained optimization, which measure the marginal control effort spent to maintain safety against each obstacle. This paper evaluates whether a horizon-weighted sum of those multipliers, a dual stress signal, provides a hazard monitor complementary to the geometric warnings the same state already supports. We compare it against a battery of fifteen geometric detectors tuned to a matched false-alarm budget, on preregistered held-out crossing scenarios driven through a physics simulator. The stress alarm actionably flags 4.7 times as many collisions missed by the entire geometric battery as the geometric battery flags in return (85 versus 18); combined, the two channels warn of three quarters of the collisions for which braking remained feasible, against under half for the geometric battery alone.
tldr: This paper introduces a 'dual stress' signal derived from KKT multipliers of a safety-constrained MPC, which serves as a runtime hazard monitor complementing traditional geometric warnings for autonomous navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从安全约束MPC的KKT乘子中提取的“双重压力”信号，作为运行时危险监控器，补充了传统几何警告在自主导航中的不足。
summary_zh: 自主导航的运行时危险监测器传统上基于几何量构建：预测间距、碰撞时间和所需减速度。通过显式约束保障安全的模型预测控制器，在每个控制步骤的副产品中会产生一个被上述监测器忽略的第二信息通道：其约束优化的卡鲁什-库恩-塔克乘子，该乘子衡量为维持针对每个障碍物的安全性所付出的边际控制代价。本文评估了这些乘子的视界加权和（即对偶应力信号）是否能为同一状态已支持的几何预警提供互补性的危险监测。我们将其与针对匹配虚警预算调优的十五个几何检测器进行对比，测试场景为通过物理仿真器驱动的预注册留出交叉场景。应力警报可操作地标记出的碰撞次数（85次）是全部几何检测器组合标记次数（18次）的4.7倍，且这些碰撞均被几何检测器遗漏；两者联合可对四分之三的制动仍可行的碰撞发出预警，而单独使用几何检测器时该比例不足一半。

title: Precise Top-Layer Fabric Segmentation for Fabric Destacking with Edge- and Shape-Aware Deep Networks
summary: Fabric destacking requires precise segmentation of the topmost fabric layer, a task complicated by subtle fabric boundaries and high visual similarity between fabric layers. Existing semantic and edge-based segmentation approaches often struggle with these complexities, limiting the performance of robotic manipulation for different tasks. In this work, a novel segmentation training architecture tailored for top-layer fabric segmentation in stacked fabrics is proposed. The method extends the classical encoder-decoder framework by introducing two specialized branches - an edge-aware branch and a shape-aware branch - that are used to supervise the backbone network for better tuning. The edge-aware branch enhances boundary delineation, while the shape-aware branch guides the network to capture and align the overall fabric shape with reference masks derived from Computer Aided Design (CAD) models. Experiments on a real-world fabric dataset demonstrate that the training approach outperforms established baselines, verifying the effectiveness of the multi-branch design through both quantitative results and ablation studies.
tldr: A multi-branch encoder-decoder network with edge-aware and shape-aware supervision achieves precise top-layer fabric segmentation for robotic destacking tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种带边缘感知和形状感知分支的多支路编解码网络，实现机器人织物拆垛任务中顶层织物的精确分割。
summary_zh: 织物拆垛需要对最上层织物进行精确分割，而织物边界细微、各层间视觉高度相似的特点使该任务更具挑战性。现有的基于语义和边缘的分割方法常难以应对这些复杂性，限制了机器人操作在不同任务中的性能。本文提出了一种专为堆叠织物中顶层织物分割设计的新型分割训练架构。该方法在经典编码器-解码器框架基础上引入两个专用分支——边缘感知分支与形状感知分支，用于监督主干网络的精细调优。边缘感知分支增强边界勾勒能力，而形状感知分支引导网络捕捉织物整体形状，并将其与计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型导出的参考掩膜对齐。基于真实织物数据集的实验表明，该训练方法在量化结果与消融研究中均优于现有基线，验证了多分支设计的有效性。

title: When Your State Estimator Has Lost The Plot: Detecting Estimator Failures Via Spectral Analysis
summary:
Reliable onboard state estimation is essential for safe robotic operation, yet unmodeled disturbances, such as sensor aliasing or out-of-distribution noise, still cause estimators to degrade or fail completely. While many methods aim to improve estimator robustness, only a few provide introspective mechanisms to assess estimate quality. Existing uncertainty measures, such as covariances, rely on idealized assumptions and tend to be overconfident, and more recent data-driven approaches are typically tied to their training data distributions.
  We propose a sensor-agnostic introspective method that assesses estimator health by analyzing the frequency-domain power distribution of recent velocity estimates. The method is evaluated using outdoor flight data from an aerial robot running visual-inertial, LiDAR-inertial, and radar-inertial odometry. The dataset includes multiple estimator failures, enabling analysis of several frequency-domain indicators, such as signal power, spectral bandwidth, and entropy. We observe consistent spectral power differences between healthy and degraded estimates, allowing detection of 51%-58% of labeled failures with 60%-84% precision across three fundamentally different state estimation frameworks. Our results show that even a simple frequency-domain analysis of a state estimator's output can serve as a lightweight introspective tool to complement existing robustness techniques in real-world robotic deployments, and opens promising avenues for future investigation.
tldr: This paper proposes a sensor-agnostic, lightweight method for detecting state estimator failures in robots by analyzing the frequency-domain power distribution of velocity estimates, demonstrated on aerial robots with multiple odometry frameworks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种传感器无关的轻量级方法，通过分析速度估计的频域功率分布来检测机器人状态估计器的失效，并在多种里程计框架的空中机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh:
可靠的机载状态估计对于机器人安全操作至关重要，然而传感器混叠或分布外噪声等未建模扰动仍会导致估计器性能下降或完全失效。尽管许多方法旨在提升估计器鲁棒性，但仅有少数方法提供了评估估计质量的内省机制。现有不确定性度量方法（如协方差）依赖于理想化假设且往往过于自信，而近年来基于数据驱动的方法通常受限于其训练数据分布。

我们提出一种与传感器无关的内省方法，通过分析近期速度估计的频域功率分布来评估估计器健康状态。该方法使用空中机器人在户外飞行时采集的视觉-惯性、激光雷达-惯性和雷达-惯性里程计数据进行评估。数据集包含多次估计器失效情况，可对信号功率、频谱带宽和熵等多项频域指标进行分析。我们观察到健康估计与退化估计之间存在一致的频谱功率差异，这使得在三种根本不同的状态估计框架中，能够以60%-84%的精确率检测出51%-58%的已标记故障。研究结果表明，即使是对状态估计器输出进行简单的频域分析，也能作为轻量级内省工具，在真实机器人部署中补充现有鲁棒性技术，并为未来研究开辟了有前景的方向。

title: PBD-AG: Persistent Baseline-Delta Active Graphs with Uncertainty-Aware Inspection for Long-Horizon Service Robots
summary: Long-horizon service robots require persistent world models that can be built autonomously in unseen environments and revised as task-relevant objects change. Existing methods rely on online mapping, which accumulates localization and observation errors, static scene representations that cannot capture persistent object changes, or holistic vision-language predictions that lack verifiable 3D geometric evidence. We present PBD-AG, a persistent baseline-delta active graph framework that decouples robot-verified stable fixtures from revisable dynamic object events. Under our framework, the robot autonomously bootstraps the structural baseline from onboard exploration and inspects discovered fixtures to ground hierarchical object beliefs. PBD-AG maintains reliability-weighted object states over geometry, semantics, identity, existence, and support relations, utilizing a geometric visibility gate to mitigate false deletions under occlusion. Inspection viewpoints are selected by a graph-conditioned policy that balances target coverage, travel cost, collision risk, and redundant observation. Simulation experiments in multiple environments and under controlled dynamic evaluation show higher aggregate coarse-fixture F1 than capability-matched controls, as well as stronger identity continuity and event recall. A qualitative physical-robot demonstration further illustrates integration with onboard sensing, providing a traceable world model for long-horizon robotic perception. The project page of PBD-AG is available at https://shuobao214.github.io/PBD-AG/
tldr: PBD-AG introduces a persistent world model framework for long-horizon service robots that decouples stable fixtures from dynamic objects, using uncertainty-aware inspection and graph-conditioned viewpoint selection to maintain reliable hierarchical object beliefs.
tldr_zh: PBD-AG 提出了一种面向长时服务机器人的持久化世界模型框架，将稳定固定物体与动态物体解耦，通过不确定性感知检查和图驱动的视点选择来维护可靠的分层物体信念。
summary_zh: 长时域服务机器人需要持久的世界模型，该模型能在未知环境中自主构建，并在任务相关物体发生变化时进行修正。现有方法依赖于在线建图，但这会累积定位与观测误差；或采用静态场景表征，无法捕捉物体的持续变化；抑或依赖整体性的视觉-语言预测，缺乏可验证的3D几何证据。本文提出PBD-AG，一种持久化基线-动态主动图框架，将经机器人验证的稳定固定件与可修正的动态物体事件解耦。在该框架下，机器人通过机载探索自主引导结构基线的生成，并对已发现的固定件进行检验，以建立层级化的物体置信度。PBD-AG在几何、语义、身份、存在及支撑关系上维护基于可靠性权重的物体状态，并利用几何可见性门控机制来减少遮挡导致的误删除。检测视点由一种图条件策略选取，该策略平衡目标覆盖、移动成本、碰撞风险与冗余观测。多环境及受控动态评估下的仿真实验表明，本方法在聚合粗粒度固定件F1值上优于能力匹配的对照组，并具备更强的身份连续性与事件回忆能力。定性实物机器人演示进一步验证了其与机载感知的集成，为长时域机器人感知提供了可追溯的世界模型。PBD-AG项目页面见：https://shuobao214.github.io/PBD-AG/

title: A Neural Network Based Teleoperation for Remote Controlled Vehicles
summary: Direct teleoperation of vehicles faces critical technical bottlenecks: communication latency and the operator's inability to physically perceive unmodeled environmental disturbances (e.g., aerodynamic drag, bank angles) coupled with highly nonlinear tire-road dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose a tailored unilateral teleoperation framework. The system integrates the Wave Variable (WV) approach to passively guarantee stability under stochastic delays, and an adaptive Radial Basis Function Network (RBFN) to actively compensate for vehicle-specific uncertainties. Unlike existing WV-neural network architectures designed for bilateral robotic arms, our framework features decoupled adaptive laws specifically designed for vehicle longitudinal and lateral dynamics. Furthermore, compared to model-heavy predictive controllers, the model-free RBFN offers rapid online adaptation without heavy computational overhead. Building upon our preliminary theoretical formulation, this brief paper presents comprehensive comparative analyses and real-world hardware validations. Simulation benchmarks against PID, LQR, MPC, and NMPC demonstrate that the RBFN achieves superior robustness against unmodeled disturbances while requiring orders of magnitude less execution time than MPC and NMPC, making it ideal for resource-constrained vehicle edge computing. Finally, hardware-in-the-loop experiments using a 1/10th scale vehicle over a 4G network validate the system's practical feasibility, safety, and robust trajectory tracking under physical road uncertainties.
tldr: This paper proposes a teleoperation framework for remote-controlled vehicles that integrates Wave Variable passivity control with an adaptive Radial Basis Function Network to handle communication latency and unmodeled dynamics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于远程操控车辆的遥操作框架，结合波变量无源控制与自适应径向基函数网络，以应对通信延迟和未建模动力学问题。
summary_zh: 车辆直接遥操作面临关键技术瓶颈：通信时延以及操作员无法物理感知未建模环境扰动（如空气阻力、侧倾角）与强非线性轮胎-路面动力学的耦合作用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种定制化的单向遥操作框架。该系统集成波变量（WV）方法以在随机时延下被动保证稳定性，并采用自适应径向基函数网络（RBFN）主动补偿车辆特异性不确定性。与现有面向双臂机器人的WV-神经网络架构不同，本框架具有专为车辆纵向与横向动力学解耦设计的自适应律。此外，相较于依赖大量模型的预测控制器，无模型RBFN无需繁重计算开销即可实现快速在线自适应。基于前期理论公式，本文通过综合性对比分析与实际硬件验证，揭示了：在PID、LQR、MPC及NMPC的仿真基准测试中，RBFN对未建模扰动展现出更优鲁棒性，且执行时间较MPC与NMPC降低数个数量级，使其成为资源受限车辆边缘计算的理想方案。最终，基于1/10比例车辆在4G网络下的硬件在环实验，验证了该系统在真实道路不确定性下的实际可行性、安全性及鲁棒轨迹跟踪性能。

title: Multi-View Relational Distillation for Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong image and video understanding, yet their visual-spatial representations remain geometrically fragile, leading to failures in spatial reasoning needed for embodied AI, robotics, and autonomous driving. Prior approaches to geometry grounding either fine-tune VLMs on spatial question answering, which can perpetuate spurious visual representations, or fuse features from large geometry-grounded vision models, which substantially increases model size at inference. Knowledge distillation from geometry-grounded vision models offers an alternative, but directly matching multi-view teacher features can disrupt the pretrained alignment between visual and textual representations, degrading object- and language-semantic capabilities. We propose multi-view relational distillation (MVRD), which distills patch-wise cosine similarities across views instead of the teacher features themselves. These relations encode geometric correspondences adequate for spatial understanding, while leaving the student representation underdetermined, allowing it to remain close to its pretrained vision- language space. Across representative VLMs, MVRD improves visual-spatial reasoning, outperforming supervised fine-tuning and feature distillation while approaching feature fusion methods with considerably fewer added parameters and lower latency. We show that MVRD makes visual representations more geometric while retaining language alignment, and generalizes to 3D scene understanding tasks such as object grounding, dense captioning, and question answering.
tldr: This paper proposes multi-view relational distillation (MVRD) to improve spatial reasoning in VLMs by transferring geometric correspondences from geometry-grounded models without disrupting vision-language alignment, benefiting embodied AI and autonomous driving tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出多视角关系蒸馏（MVRD），通过从几何基础模型转移几何对应关系来改进VLM的空间推理能力，同时保持视觉语言对齐，有益于具身AI和自动驾驶任务。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在图像与视频理解方面已取得显著成效，但其视觉空间表征在几何结构上仍存在脆弱性，导致在具身智能、机器人及自动驾驶所需的空间推理任务中表现不佳。现有的几何表征方法要么通过在空间问答任务上微调VLM（这可能导致虚假视觉表征的持续存在），要么融合来自大规模几何感知视觉模型的特征（这会显著增加推理时的模型规模）。从几何感知视觉模型进行知识蒸馏虽提供另一种思路，但直接匹配多视角教师特征可能破坏视觉与文本表征之间预训练的对齐关系，从而削弱物体识别与语言语义能力。本文提出多视角关系蒸馏（MVRD）方法，该方法在不同视角间蒸馏块级余弦相似度而非教师特征本身。这些关系编码了足以支撑空间理解的几何对应信息，同时使学生表征保持欠定状态，从而使其能维持接近预训练的视觉-语言空间。在代表性VLM上的实验表明，MVRD能提升视觉空间推理能力，其性能优于监督微调和特征蒸馏方法，同时以显著更少的参数量和更低延迟接近特征融合方法。我们证实MVRD在保持语言对齐的同时使视觉表征更具几何特性，并能泛化至三维场景理解任务，包括目标定位、密集描述和问答。

title: GESTO: Human-Centric Spatio-Temporal Memory for Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
summary: Robots operating in human environments need memories that capture not only what objects exist and where, but also how people use them over time and how individual interactions compose into goal-directed activities.
